facts.value: University of Luxembourg housing: from € 450/month (2026), deposit = 2 months' rent; private-market rooms are 'significantly more expensive'. Housing not guaranteed.
facts.source_name: University of Luxembourg – Cost of living & budget

interpretations.hypothesis: Minimum monthly rental budget to state in the housing request is € 400 for Bachelor, Master and incoming exchange students (€ 800 for salaried doctoral students).

facts.notes: University residences are spread over Esch-sur-Alzette, Belvaux and other towns; a specific residence cannot be chosen. No citable private-room figure for Esch found.

facts.value: 1-bedroom flat ~€ 1,233/month outside centre, ~€ 1,633 in centre (Nov 2026; only 13 entries from 1 contributor).
facts.notes: Very thin sample (1 contributor) and it is a 1-bedroom, not a studio. University studios (Type 3, ~24 m²) exist but their rent is not published on the pages read.

facts.value: Uni.lu estimates: rent from € 450 + canteen meals € 360 + phone € 40 + leisure € 150 per month; immigration requires ≥ € 18,652 per academic year (2026).
facts.source_name: University of Luxembourg – Cost of living & budget
facts.notes: Uni.lu gives no single monthly total. Also: registration € 400/semester (may vary by programme), study materials € 400/year, starting budget ≥ € 2,700 on arrival.

facts.value: € 0: buses, trams and 2nd-class trains are free nationwide since 1 March 2020 (1st class and cross-border trips excluded).
Temperate: mean 1.4 °C in January, 18.7 °C in July, 9.8 °C yearly; 831 mm rain/year (Luxembourg-Findel, normals 1991–2020).
facts.notes: Station is Luxembourg-Findel (about 20 km from Esch), not Esch itself.

facts.value: Esch, next to the Belval campus, is described as growing in popularity, with venues such as Kulturfabrik and Rockhal; Luxembourg City is a free train ride away.
Admin languages: Luxembourgish, French, German. French is the main work language; English is the lingua franca of the international community and finance. Check your programme's language.
facts.notes: Country-level page; 2018 study cited there: 98% speak French, 80% English, 78% German, 77% Luxembourgish.

facts.value: All uni.lu students may work (15 h/week in term, holiday contracts). Jobs via Jugendinfo.lu, Moovijob, uni.lu Career Centre, Unicareers fair; many listings in French/German.
facts.source_name: Luxembourg.lu – Jobs and internships for pupils and students; University of Luxembourg
facts.notes: No sector breakdown or availability data found for Esch. Non-EU first-year Bachelor students: see the conflicting rules in luxembourg/bureaucracy.json (lu-student-work-non-eu).

facts.value: Term-time student contract: ≥ minimum wage, € 16.0192/h gross for 18+ unskilled (from 1 June 2026). Holiday contract: ≥ 80% of it, i.e. € 12.8154/h at 18+.
facts.source_name: Guichet.lu – Social parameters; Guichet.lu – student contracts
facts.notes: These are legal floors, not typical market pay (none found). The € 12.8154/h holiday figure is 80% of € 16.0192, which is also the official 17–18 rate in the table. Luxembourg.lu's student wage table is still at the 1 Jan 2024 index.
